title: City College’s year-end books omitted a $3 million grant receipt

beats.text: A $3 million grant receipt reached City College’s books after year-end.
That left cash and revenue understated in the closing records.

visual.kicker: The state filing omitted a $3 million grant receipt

beats.text: The auditors also checked what students still owed.

beats.text: The college allowed $1 million for noncollection. Its method called for $2.5 million.
A receivable in one college fund lacked a matching payable in another.

visual.kicker: Receivables and interfund entries also needed work

beats.text: A different schedule held about $5.5 million in unexplained negative entries.
The district lacked detailed records from 2001 and earlier.

visual.kicker: Historical capital records had unexplained negative entries
